title: Compute brief - 9 October 2026
description: AWS Capacity Blocks live table finally prints the 7 Oct banner rates (five AWS ticks). DigitalOcean AMD spot MI355X and MI350X also jump. Two Wire ids: Applied Digital secures access to up to 1 GW of potential power in Finland; DarkHorse signs up to 50 MW with Hopkinsville Electric System in Kentucky. Tape: 62 confirms, 7 ticks, 0 NEW.
og_kicker: AWS CB table ticks; APLD Finland; DarkHorse KY
lede: Friday's tape finally moves. The AWS Capacity Blocks live table now prints the rates that sat in the banner since 7 Oct: P5 $5.970 (was $5.191), P5e $6.866, P5en $7.895, P6-B200 $14.208, and P6-B300 $16.146. DigitalOcean AMD spot also jumped, with MI355X at $5.50 (was $2.97) and MI350X at $3.50 (was $2.46). On conversion, Applied Digital locked access to up to 1 GW of potential power in Finland for a first non-US AI Factory campus (initial power from 2028, counterparty unnamed), and DarkHorse signed up to 50 MW with Hopkinsville Electric System for a new Kentucky superintelligence factory, doubling its TVA-region contracted power to about 100 MW. The rest of the public rental tape is a confirm session: 62 confirms, 7 ticks, 0 NEW across Lambda, CoreWeave NA and EU, Crusoe, DigitalOcean, GCP TPU and AWS Capacity Blocks.
